description: The finite Boolean truth-table tautology test returns true exactly when the formula is a tautology.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.checkTautology_eq_true.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.checkTautology A = true ↔ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Tautology A
